Not criminalisation of trans identity. I'd say ~0.58-0.64. The vague penal code used for arrests is concerning but not trans-specific. The healthcare discrimination and violence risk for trans women is documented but framed for residents. 2025 Pride cancellation signals state hostility emerging.
